name: Adar
overview: Adar is identified in Scripture both as the twelfth month in the Jewish calendar and as a personal name, specifically a son of Bela. The month of Adar holds particular significance in the book of Esther, where key events such as the casting of lots by Haman and the deliverance of the Jews occur on the thirteenth day of Adar. Additionally, Ezra records the completion of the temple in the month of Adar during the reign of King Darius, highlighting its importance in the historical and redemptive timeline of Israel.
